exact_results.index: chi in S_k iff Cayley(chi) in N_k
exact_results.limit_closure: q_n in N_{<=K} and local meromorphic q_n->q implies q in N_{<=K}

consequence: A bounded-index finite transfer converging to chi_infty bounds the number of distinct right-half off-critical xi-zero locations by the same uniform index bound.

provenance.classical_criterion: RH iff Re[xi'/xi](s)>0 on Re(s)>1/2 is classical (Hinkkanen; highlighted by Lagarias 1999).
provenance.coordinate_rewrite: With s=1/2-i z, Im Q_xi(z)=Re[xi'/xi](s), so RH iff Q_xi in N_0 is the same classical criterion in Nevanlinna coordinates.
provenance.project_specific_layer: The project-specific result is the Cayley/Pontryagin crosswalk from localized Suzuki/de Branges negative-square data to this classical target.
